memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Epilepsy, well controlled on current regimen.
Patient reports no seizures, no aura, no postictal confusion. She feels energetic and continues her lectures without difficulty. Examination: alert, oriented, cranial nerves normal, motor strength 5/5 bilaterally, coordination intact, gait steady. No focal neurologic deficits. Smoking status: never smoker. No inhaler prescribed. Technique checked: not applicable.
